title: US petroleum use peaked in 2005 and has not passed 20.8 million barrels a day since

alt: Horizontal bars of deaths by type of natural disaster, 1900–2017. Drought (11.7 million) and epidemic (9.6 million) are 65 % of the 33 million.

title: Fertility falls as people live longer; China and India are 48 % of those shown

alt: Bubble chart of fertility against life expectancy in 2005, bubble area is population. Longer-lived countries have fewer children (r = -0.86); China and India are the two largest bubbles, 48 % of the people.

title: Typical life expectancy rose 22 years since 1950, and the spread fell 33 %

alt: Hexagonal-bin density of life expectancy by year, 1950–2023. The median rose from 53 in the 1950s to 74 in 2014–2023, and the standard deviation across countries fell from 12 to 8 years.
